# Screening and Room Rules
Fenwray Film Society is a fictional organisation.

Adopted: 20 February 2025
Effective: 1 March 2025

## 1. Screening schedule
1.1 The society normally holds two public screenings each month.
1.2 The committee confirms dates at least 21 days beforehand.
1.3 Screenings take place in a room hired by the society.
1.4 The society does not own or permanently control the room.
1.5 The secretary maintains the official screening calendar.

## 2. Reservations
2.1 Reservations open 14 calendar days before each screening.
2.2 Reservations close two hours before the advertised start time.
2.3 Each person may reserve no more than four tickets per screening.
2.4 Reservations are confirmed only when full payment is received.
2.5 Ticket prices are set by film-fees.md.
2.6 Unpaid requests do not reserve seats.

## 3. Capacity and entry
3.1 The maximum audience is 42 people, excluding duty volunteers.
3.2 At least two duty volunteers must attend every public screening.
3.3 Doors open 30 minutes before the advertised start time.
3.4 Reserved seats are held until 10 minutes after the advertised start.
3.5 Late arrivals may enter only during a suitable break.
3.6 Entry is refused once the permitted audience capacity is reached.

## 4. Cancellations and changes
4.1 The coordinator may cancel a screening for safety or room unavailability.
4.2 A changed film title must be announced before doors open.
4.3 Ticket refunds are determined by film-refunds.md.
4.4 The coordinator records the reason for any cancellation.

## 5. Room and audience safety
5.1 Exit routes must be checked before the audience enters.
5.2 The room must be cleared within 30 minutes after the screening ends.
5.3 Equipment must be placed so cables do not obstruct walking routes.
5.4 The duty volunteers apply the safety rules in film-safety.md.
5.5 Audience conduct is governed by film-conduct.md.

# Committee Changes Register
Fenwray Film Society is a fictional organisation.

Maintained by the secretary.
Earlier governing text remains on file and is not rewritten.

## 1. Decision of 16 June 2025
1.1 Replaces section 1.1 Annual adult membership in film-fees.md.
1.2 From 1 July 2025, annual adult membership costs £28 instead of £24.
1.3 The date membership payment is received determines the fee.
1.4 Payments received before 1 July 2025 retain the old fee.

## 2. Decision of 10 September 2025
2.1 Replaces section 3.1 Refundable security deposit in film-equipment.md.
2.2 From 1 October 2025, the deposit is £100 instead of £80.
2.3 The scheduled collection date determines the deposit required.
2.4 Earlier confirmed bookings are subject to the new deposit if collected on or after that date.

## 3. Decision of 19 January 2026
3.1 Replaces section 2.2 Member admission in film-fees.md.
3.2 From 1 February 2026, active members pay £5 instead of £4.
3.3 The screening date determines the ticket price, including advance purchases.

## 4. Decision of 12 March 2026
4.1 Replaces section 2.2 Maximum equipment hire in film-equipment.md.
4.2 From 1 April 2026, the maximum hire is five consecutive booking days.
4.3 The scheduled first collection date determines the permitted duration.

## 5. Decision of 22 May 2026
5.1 Replaces section 3.1 Maximum audience in film-screenings.md.
5.2 From 1 June 2026, the maximum audience is 36, excluding duty volunteers.
5.3 The screening date determines the audience limit.

## 6. Decision of 14 August 2026
6.1 Replaces section 1.2 Early ticket cancellation in film-refunds.md.
6.2 From 1 September 2026, a full refund requires at least 72 hours' notice.
6.3 The scheduled screening date determines which notice period applies.
6.4 Section 1.4 of film-refunds.md still determines when notice was received.

Under sections 3.3 and 3.4 of the Fenwray Film Society's screening rules (`film-screenings.md`), for a screening advertised at 19:30 on 18 November 2025:

- **Seat hold:** The society must hold the reserved seat until **19:40**. Reserved seats are held until 10 minutes after the advertised start.
- **Doors:** Doors normally open at **19:00**, 30 minutes before the advertised start.

The committee's changes register doesn't alter either rule. Its only amendment to this file concerns the maximum audience, which doesn't affect these times.

Under section 3.5, someone who arrives after the film starts may enter only during a suitable break.
